name: CollapsedMenu
material_impl: Shared OptimizedGlass (level3/strong) plus raw Tailwind hover:bg-white/10 and glass-focus-ring-white-opacity-30 utilities; no tokens for item surfaces.
motion: CSS transition-all + hover translate; gated by useReducedMotion via respectMotionPreference (wired, L29-30, L60).
a11y: Wrapper is role=navigation but children are role=menuitem with no role=menu parent (invalid ARIA, L42/L53); every item tabIndex=0 with no arrow-key/Escape handling; aria-label optional and unset by default; buttons lack type=button.
api: forwardRef but items: any[] and onItemClick(item: any) (L10-11); no style passthrough; absolute positioning hard-coded (top-full right-0).
duplicates: GlassDropdownMenu (overflow menu should be a DropdownMenu)
justification: A private overflow popover for GlassTabBar that re-implements menu semantics incorrectly (menuitems inside a navigation landmark, no roving focus, no Escape). The library already has a far more complete GlassDropdownMenu; GlassTabBar should use it and this file should be deleted along with its story/test which only exist to bump coverage.

name: ScrollButtons
material_impl: Inline createGlassStyle({intent:'neutral', elevation:'level2'}) per button (L26, L37).
a11y: aria-label present, type=button; glyphs are text characters (‹/›) not icons; glass-touch-target class only.
api: Not forwardRef; className interpolated as template string so missing className renders literal 'undefined' class (L28, L39); no disabled state.
target: IconButton with library chevron icons inside GlassTabBar
justification: Trivial internal helper using typographic chevrons and a className bug that emits 'undefined'. Not a design-system component; fold into GlassTabBar using the shared IconButton and @/icons ChevronLeft/Right.

name: TabItem
material_impl: Bespoke inline styles: active background rgba(255,255,255,0.28), badge rgba(255,255,255,0.3), hard-coded padding 8px 16px / radius 6px (L99-118, L143-150). No glass primitive.
motion: Inline 'transition: all 0.2s ease' with no reduced-motion handling (L117).
a11y: role=tab, aria-selected, roving tabIndex, Arrow/Home/End handling via DOM query of siblings (L55-87) - reasonable. Badge renders falsy 0 as text '0' (L140) and aria-label 'N notifications' assumes semantics. Duplicate class list string (L124).
api: Not forwardRef; spreads rest; style merge OK; id is prefixed 'tab-' globally so two tab bars with same ids collide (L93).
justification: Keyboard handling is actually decent, but it is a second private tab-trigger implementation with hard-coded rgba and px values while a public GlassTabItem exists. Merge into one tab trigger used by every tab component.

name: EnhancedGlassTabs
material_impl: OptimizedGlass container; tab colors via getTabColors returning hard-coded rgba(255,255,255,0.28)/0.82 plus color-mix tokens (L186-207). The color prop computes selectedColor that is never used (L183-184) - color variants are dead.
motion: Indicator slides with CSS transition; reduced motion wired. But transition classes are built with template literals (glass-duration-[${ANIMATION.DURATION.fast}ms] L470, L536) which no static CSS pipeline can generate, so transitions likely no-op.
a11y: Roving tabIndex (inactive = -1, L464) with NO onKeyDown arrow handler anywhere -> keyboard users can only reach the active tab and can never switch tabs. aria-controls points to non-existent 'tabpanel-*' ids (L466). Wrapped in a <nav> landmark (tabs are not navigation). Dark mode via OS media query, not theme (L211-225). Hover colors mutated imperatively via e.currentTarget.style (L500-511).
api: forwardRef exposes imperative handle (not the DOM node); size small|medium|large conflicts with library sm|md|lg; physicsEnabled prop unused; color prop dead; controlled/uncontrolled partially (activeTab sync effect).
ssr: 'use client'; window.matchMedia in effect only; ResizeObserver in effect; OK.
fake_complexity: 'High-contrast, accessibility-focused' docblock (L5) is false: no keyboard navigation; 'physicsEnabled' does nothing.
justification: One of at least six tab implementations, and the one whose marketing ('accessibility-focused') is most contradicted by code: keyboard users cannot change tabs, panels it claims to control do not exist, the color prop is dead, and its motion classes cannot compile. GlassPageTabs already does APG-correct tabs; deprecate this with a codemod mapping tabs/activeTab/onChange to tabs/value/onChange.

name: GlassBottomNav
material_impl: OptimizedGlass level2 container with GlassButton primary/ghost items; 'elevation' prop is accepted but ignored (hard-coded elevation='level2' L237). Variant styling relies on glass-border-glass-border/20 utilities.
motion: Active icon scale via CSS (gated by reduced motion); Motion preset for dot indicator.
a11y: Uses role=tablist/tab for app navigation instead of <nav> + links with aria-current (L165, L260). Inactive items tabIndex=-1 with no arrow-key handler (L168) -> keyboard users can only reach the active destination. aria-controls references non-existent nav-panel-* ids (L167). aria-label hard-coded 'Bottom navigation' and cannot be overridden before ...props spread order (it can via props, but id is overwritten).
api: forwardRef OK; item.href is declared but never rendered as a link (L17 unused) - no router/Link integration; renderItem escape hatch; elevation type (0-4|float|modal) mismatches OptimizedGlass levels.
fake_complexity: None, but 'safeArea' adds class pb-safe that has no visible definition in the shard.
target: Merge with LiquidGlassTabBar as a single link-based bottom tab bar
justification: The core mobile chrome surface, but it misuses tab semantics for navigation, traps keyboard users on the active item, ignores href and elevation, and stacks a GlassButton pill inside a glass slab rather than reading as an iOS-grade tab bar. Rebuild on LiquidGlassMaterial with nav/a + aria-current, asChild for router links and real safe-area insets.

name: GlassBreadcrumb (+ GlassBreadcrumbItem, GlassBreadcrumbSeparator, GlassBreadcrumbLink, GlassBreadcrumbCompound)
material_impl: OptimizedGlass pill plus redundant raw Tailwind 'glass-backdrop-blur-md ring-1 ring-white/10 bg-white/10' stacked on top (L180).
motion: Hover translate on items, gated by useReducedMotion per item.
a11y: nav/ol/li structure and aria-current correct. But the <nav> sits INSIDE the glass div and the glass div also receives ...props including aria-label (double label). Only GlassBreadcrumb is root-exported (src/index.ts:91) - Item/Link/Separator/Compound are not, so consumers cannot build accessible items with aria-current from the public API. GlassBreadcrumbLink with isCurrentPage drops the ref and the rest props (L332-337). Separator in container is aria-hidden (good) but GlassBreadcrumbSeparator would double-render separators if used with the container.
api: forwardRef with ref as any; style: computed maxWidth style is overwritten by the later {...props} spread containing style (L186-197) so maxWidth/contained are lost whenever style is passed; maxItems truncation logic is duplicated twice (L131-144, L152-167) and maxItems=1 yields slice(-0) = whole array; keys are array index.
target: single Breadcrumb family (merge with app-shell GlassBreadcrumbs; export Item/Link/Separator)
justification: Structurally sound breadcrumb with correct list semantics, but three breadcrumb implementations exist, the compound parts are not publicly exported, the style-spread bug defeats the contained/maxWidth features, and maxItems math is duplicated and wrong at edge values. Merge into one family with asChild links.

name: GlassCommandBar
material_impl: OptimizedGlass level2 container; buttons use raw utility strings (hover:glass-bg-white/10 glass-border-white/10); kbd chip glass-surface-subtle/10.
motion: Hover scale 105% gated by reduced motion.
a11y: role=toolbar with aria-label hard-coded 'Command bar' (L59) but no roving-tabindex arrow navigation as the toolbar pattern requires; buttons lack type=button; shortcut is visual only (no aria-keyshortcuts).
api: forwardRef targets the inner glass, while className goes to inner and position wrapper div is unreachable; returns null on non-array items; 'position' only toggles a margin.
fake_complexity: Named 'CommandBar' but it is a wrapped row of buttons - no command search, no overflow.
justification: A 111-line button row that overlaps five other toolbar/action-bar components and lacks the toolbar keyboard model its role promises. Fold into the toolbar family as a 'compact actions' variant.

name: GlassContextMenu (+ GlassContextMenuContent, GlassContextMenuItem, useContextMenu)

tests.notes: no test clicks a menu item with real pointer sequence

material_impl: OptimizedGlass level4 with liftOnHover + hoverSheen plus raw 'glass-backdrop-blur-lg bg-white/10 border border-white/20 shadow-2xl' stacked (L299) - double material; destructive uses Tailwind text-red-400 rather than danger token.
motion: Motion preset scaleIn (primitive honours reduced motion); items hover translate unconditionally; respectMotionPreference prop declared but never destructured or used (L68).
a11y: BLOCKER: document 'mousedown' listener closes the menu on ANY mousedown including inside the menu (L172-182, no target check), so the menu unmounts before 'click' fires and mouse selection of items cannot work. No focus moved into the menu on open; trigger div is not focusable and there is no keyboard way to open (cert DOM shows only the 3 skip links focusable). Menu items are tabIndex=0 each (not roving). Submenu is nested inside the parent role=menu as a div sibling without proper aria-controls.
api: React.FC (no forwardRef); menuClassName ?? className applies the trigger class to the menu too (L223); position adjustment writes style imperatively; useContextMenu.createSeparator uses Date.now() ids (duplicate keys when called twice in a tick, L499).
fake_complexity: None, but align/side positioning ignores pointer location for side='bottom' default (y forced to rect.bottom, L162) so a right-click menu does not open at the cursor by default.
target: GlassContextMenu rebuilt on GlassDropdownMenu content/item primitives (Positioner at pointer, DismissableLayer, FocusScope autoFocus)
justification: The outside-click handler closes the menu on mousedown inside it, so the primary interaction (click an item) is broken; there is no keyboard entry, default positioning ignores the cursor, and material is double-stacked. The dropdown family already has DismissableLayer/Positioner/FocusScope - rebuild the context menu as a thin trigger over those.

name: GlassDropdownMenu (+ Trigger, Content, Item, CheckboxItem, RadioGroup, RadioItem, Label, Separator, Shortcut, Sub, SubTrigger, SubContent)

tests.notes: keyboard test fires keyDown on the menu node directly, masking the focus-entry gap

material_impl: Bespoke: inline background rgba(255,255,255,0.24), border rgba(255,255,255,0.24), backdropFilter 'blur(24px) saturate(1.45) brightness(1.04) contrast(1.04)' hard-coded in Content and duplicated in SubContent (L320-326, L882-888); does NOT use OptimizedGlass/LiquidGlassMaterial or tokens.
motion: Motion scaleIn wrapper plus Radix/tailwindcss-animate data-state classes (animate-in, zoom-in-95, slide-in-from-top-2) that this repo does not ship - dead classes.
a11y: Good skeleton (Radix-like): aria-haspopup/expanded/controls on trigger, roles menu/menuitem/menuitemcheckbox/menuitemradio, Arrow/Home/End/Escape with focus return. Gaps: Item has no Enter/Space handler - div role=menuitem only reacts to click, so keyboard users cannot activate items (L446-462); FocusScope is used without autoFocus (L372, FocusScope autoFocus defaults false) so focus stays on trigger after Enter/ArrowDown open; RadioItem indicator dot is glass-bg-transparent (L608) - selected radio is invisible; no typeahead.
api: Best API in shard: controlled/uncontrolled via useControllableOpen, asChild trigger via Slot, onSelect with preventDefault, portal/contained strategies, forwardRef everywhere, DropdownMenu namespace. 'modal' prop accepted and discarded.
ssr: 'use client'; Portal used; document access only in handlers.
justification: The only menu in the library with a credible primitive architecture (controllable state, Slot, Positioner, DismissableLayer, FocusScope, sub-menus). It should become the single menu engine for context menu, menubar, header user menu and tab overflow. Required polish: Enter/Space activation, autofocus first item on open, typeahead, visible radio indicator, replace hard-coded rgba/blur with the shared Liquid Glass material and tokens, remove dead tailwindcss-animate classes.

name: GlassHeader (+ internal NotificationButton, UserMenu; exported-from-file HeaderBreadcrumbs, HeaderNavigation, ConsciousGlassHeader, PredictiveHeader, GazeResponsiveHeader, AccessibleHeader, HeaderConsciousnessPresets)

tests.notes: templated render/axe/snapshot; no behaviour tests for menus or search

material_impl: Two full render paths: LiquidGlassMaterial (material='liquid') and OptimizedGlass with an overriding inline style background rgba(255,255,255,0.12) + hard-coded triple box-shadow (L631-635). ~240 lines of JSX duplicated verbatim between the two paths (L393-612 vs L639-855). Dropdowns use arbitrary glass-shadow-[...rgba(2,8,23,0.55)] utilities.
motion: Motion slideDown for dropdowns; hamburger morph via Tailwind duration-[${...}ms] template classes (L402) which cannot compile; no reduced-motion handling in header itself.
a11y: Root gets role=navigation AND contains nested <nav> elements (double landmark, L629/L432); should be <header>/banner. Notification and user menus use full-viewport click-catcher divs (L995-1000, L1248-1253) instead of DismissableLayer; user menu items are plain buttons without role=menu/menuitem despite aria-haspopup=menu; mobile search button focuses document.querySelector('input[placeholder*=Search]') globally - may focus another component's input (L840-843); suggestions list not a combobox/listbox.
api: Violates Rules of Hooks: hooks called conditionally (predictive ? usePredictiveEngine() : null, etc. L181-189) - toggling a prop between renders crashes React. Each consciousness hook throws outside its provider, so ConsciousGlassHeader/GazeResponsiveHeader crash without 4-5 providers. External style prop is silently overridden (comment L361). Scroll effect re-subscribes on every scroll because state is in deps (L229-235). trackNavigation is defined but never called (L288). UserMenu navigates with window.location.href (L1036) - breaks SPA routers.
ssr: 'use client'; window only in effects, but module imports ~6.4k lines of advanced 'consciousness' modules (PredictiveEngine, AchievementSystem, BiometricAdaptation, EyeTracking/webgazer, SpatialAudio) even for a plain header (L25-32) - heavy bundle cost.
fake_complexity: Severe. Hard-coded fake notifications rendered whenever an action has id 'notifications' ('New evaluation completed', 'GPT-4 vs Claude-3.5 Sonnet', 'Sarah Chen joined your organization', badge '3') - demo data in library code (L911-987). 'Biometric' header resizes on 'stress level' (L238-260); 'gaze responsive' only adds shadow-lg; 'Predicted' suggestions with emoji labels; 'AccessibleHeader' preset is just biometric + spatial audio.
duplicates: HeaderBreadcrumbs vs GlassBreadcrumb vs app-shell GlassBreadcrumbs
target: GlassTopBar (app-shell) composed with GlassDropdownMenu, GlassBreadcrumb and a real search combobox
justification: The library's primary header ships fake product data, conditional hooks, a 240-line duplicated render path, double navigation landmarks, global DOM querying, full-page click catchers and ~6.4k lines of pseudo-scientific 'consciousness' imports. None of that belongs in a premium first-party header. Replace with a slim, slot-based top bar (app-shell GlassTopBar) and delete the Conscious/Predictive/Gaze/Accessible variants and presets.

name: GlassMenubar (+ GlassMenubarContent, GlassMenubarItem, useMenubar, createFileMenu, createEditMenu)
material_impl: Built on GlassMenuPrimitive (OptimizedGlass root + DismissableLayer content). Every item inherits GlassMenuPrimitiveItem's inline bordered pill (rgba 0.18 bg, 0.3 border, radius 12, marginBottom 8) so the menubar renders as a column/row of bordered buttons rather than a menubar.
motion: Motion scaleIn on content (primitive honours reduced motion); underline after: transition.
a11y: Submenus are rendered as a nested GlassMenubar -> role=menubar inside a menu (L243-250) - invalid ARIA. Every item focusable (no roving tabindex). Hover close bug: GlassMenubarItem onMouseLeave calls onCloseSubmenu which clears ALL open menus (L366-368, L216), so moving the pointer from a top item into its submenu closes it. Separators render twice (parent L197-206 and item L370-377).
api: React.FC (no forwardRef), no style passthrough; MenuItem type duplicates ContextMenuItem/NavigationItem shapes; createFileMenu/createEditMenu export no-op demo actions in library code (L573-659); useMenubar separator ids from Date.now().
ssr: 'use client'; document listeners in effects only.
fake_complexity: Preset menus with empty action bodies ('implement based on your needs').
justification: Recursive self-nesting produces invalid menubar-in-menu semantics, hover closes submenus before the pointer can reach them, separators double-render, and the visual is a stack of bordered pills. A desktop-app menubar is valuable for a premium kit but must be rebuilt as a compound API over the dropdown engine.

name: GlassMenuPrimitive (Root, Content, Item)
material_impl: Root: OptimizedGlass + redundant 'glass-backdrop-blur-md ring-1 ring-white/10 bg-white/5'. Content: DismissableLayer with raw Tailwind blur/bg/border. Item: hard-coded inline rgba background/border, 12px radius, two-layer box-shadow and marginBottom 8 (L132-146) - an item style no menu should have.
motion: None (item hover translate class only, no reduced-motion gate).
a11y: Root is always role=menubar regardless of use; Item is a plain button without role (consumer must add); FocusScope loop in Content good; min-height 44 touch target good.
api: forwardRef on all parts; namespace export. Content 'positionStrategy' is only a data attribute. Inline style + className both define padding/radius (conflicting sources of truth).
fake_complexity: Called a 'primitive' but hard-codes visual opinions (pill items with margin) that leak into every consumer.
justification: A second, weaker menu primitive alongside the dropdown engine, with hard-coded item chrome that makes the menubar look like a button stack. Collapse into one headless menu primitive (shared by dropdown, context, menubar) with material applied from tokens.

name: GlassMobileNav
material_impl: OptimizedGlass level2 drawer (elevation prop 'modal' default is ignored); backdrop is Motion div with inline white rgba(255,255,255,0.2) + gradient overlay + backdrop blur (L319-323) - a white scrim, odd for dark themes.
motion: CSS transform slide with explicit prefersReducedMotion branch and motion-reduce:transition-none (wired, L354-356); Motion slideDown for children.
a11y: Best of the nav group: role=dialog, aria-modal, inert when closed, FocusTrap with restoreFocus/autoFocus/Escape, body scroll lock with restore, close button labelled. Gaps: items are GlassButtons even when href is set (no <a>, so no open-in-new-tab, no aria-current; active state only visual) (L243-254); expandable items lack aria-expanded; '▶' glyph chevron and '×' close icon text.
api: forwardRef; open/onOpenChange controlled only; variant overlay|push|slide all map to identical classes (positionClasses L143-164) - push/slide are fake variants; elevation unused; renderItem escape hatch.
ssr: 'use client'; document.body access in effect only.
fake_complexity: variant='push' and 'slide' do nothing different from 'overlay'.
justification: Solid dialog mechanics (focus trap, inert, scroll lock, reduced motion) make this the most production-ready nav surface here, but items must render real links with aria-current, the fake push/slide variants and ignored elevation should be removed or implemented, and the white scrim should be theme-aware. Longer term it should be the Sheet primitive + a nav list rather than a standalone drawer.

name: GlassNavigation (alias GlassNavbar)
material_impl: OptimizedGlass container; inline rgba styles on buttons (rgba(100,116,139,.16), rgba(255,255,255,.16), rgba(148,163,184,.28)); active state uses Tailwind text-blue-200/bg-blue-500/15 - off-palette blue that fails contrast on light glass.
motion: Indicator via CSS transition, hidden under reduced motion; useAnimationContext spring config resolved (L160-177) but never applied to anything.
a11y: Outer <nav> wraps an OptimizedGlass with role=navigation (double landmark, L467/L480); <ul role=menubar> containing links/buttons without menuitem roles (invalid); posinset/setsize on links; the 'Tooltip' is a div title (L42-48); mobile toggle classes 'hidden md:hidden lg:hidden max-md:flex' depend on Tailwind that the package does not ship (only a storybook-utility-shim).
api: forwardRef; glassIntensity and showLabels destructured and never used; renderNavItem useCallback deps omit position/items/handleNavKeyDown; huge prop surface (types.ts) with mixed id/key identity.
fake_complexity: Stub Icon component renders the same '🔹' emoji for every icon name (menu, close, chevrons, expand) (L36-40) - the mobile toggle, collapse button and expand indicators all show a blue diamond. Imports spring physics and animation context that do nothing.
justification: A catch-all navbar whose icons are a placeholder emoji, whose tooltips are title attributes, whose spring/intensity props are dead, and whose responsive toggle depends on Tailwind classes the package does not ship. It overlaps the header, sidebar and app-shell top bar. Remove (keep GlassNavbar alias pointing at the replacement for one major).

name: GlassNavigationMenu (+ GlassNavigationMenuContent, GlassNavigationMenuItem, useNavigationMenu, createDashboardNavigation, createAdminNavigation)
material_impl: OptimizedGlass as='nav' plus variant utility strings (glass-backdrop-blur ring-1 ring-white/10); nested submenus re-render a full OptimizedGlass nav inside (glass-on-glass stacking, L239); badges glass-surface-red; featured dot glass-surface-yellow with pulse.
motion: Motion slideDown/rotateIn presets; hover-intent timers 120/180ms; featured indicator animate-pulse with no reduced-motion gate.
a11y: OptimizedGlass as='nav' AND role='navigation' (redundant); every nested submenu is another <nav> landmark; links are rendered as <button> and navigate via window.location.href / window.open (L150-158) - no real anchors, no middle-click, no aria-current; submenu toggle is a <span> with aria-label and onClick but not focusable (L467-481); aria-haspopup='menu' on disclosure (should be aria-expanded only).
api: React.FC (no forwardRef); NavigationItem type name collides with types.ts NavigationItem used by GlassNavigation; useNavigationMenu also hard-navigates; demo presets with emoji icons exported from library.
fake_complexity: None, but 'Advanced navigation menu' is a disclosure list.
justification: A disclosure nav list that hard-navigates with window.location, renders links as buttons, nests landmarks and glass-in-glass, and ships emoji demo presets. Its job is the sidebar tree; merge into the sidebar family with link/asChild items.

name: GlassPageTabs
material_impl: CSS module (GlassPageTabs.module.css) with layered surface: backdrop-filter from --aura-glass-neutral-level2-backdrop-blur token, ::before specular gradient, inset highlight + hairline + soft drop shadow tokens; selected trigger gradient. Tokens with fallbacks throughout; but ink is hard-coded to black (--glass-page-tabs-ink rgba(black/0.9), CSS L2-19) so it is light-theme only.
motion: CSS transitions on tokenised durations/easing; prefers-reduced-motion block disables transitions and press scale (CSS L259-267).
a11y: APG-correct: tablist/tab/tabpanel wiring with useId ids, roving tabIndex, Arrow/Home/End skipping disabled, automatic vs manual activation, panel aria-labelledby + tabIndex 0, visible focus ring token, forced-colors and prefers-reduced-transparency support (CSS L269-303). Missing: vertical orientation still accepts Left/Right (fine), no dark-theme ink.
api: forwardRef, controlled/uncontrolled (value/defaultValue/onChange), orientation, activationMode, renderPanel; className/props passthrough. Data-driven only (tabs array) - no compound Tabs.List/Trigger/Panel for custom layouts; no size variant.
ssr: 'use client'; document.getElementById only in handlers; useId-safe ids.
justification: The reference implementation in this shard: real APG keyboard model, tokenised CSS-module material with specular layer, reduced-motion/transparency/forced-colors handling, SSR-safe ids. It should be the base of a single Tabs family (add compound parts, dark-theme ink tokens, size scale, tests, and a certification screenshot) and the other five tab components should be deprecated into it.

name: GlassPagination (+ GlassPaginationContent, GlassPaginationItem, usePagination, GlassPaginationWithInfo)

tests.notes: templated; no keyboard or page-change interaction test

material_impl: Every page number is its own OptimizedGlass (liftOnHover, press, glass-sheen, level1/level3) inside an OptimizedGlass container plus redundant 'glass-backdrop-blur-md' and Tailwind bg-white/8|12|15 - N+1 backdrop-filter layers per pagination (L259-269, L417-443). Also an 'ink' underline bar under the active page.
motion: CSS hover lift; ink indicator transitions width/left with no reduced-motion handling; spinner animate-spin.
a11y: BLOCKER: page/prev/next/first/last items are <div role=button> with no tabIndex and no Enter/Space handler (L405-446; createPaginationA11y adds only aria-* in src/utils/a11y.ts:678-695) - pagination is mouse-only. Certification DOM confirms: focusableElementCount=3 (only the story skip links). Disabled items still receive onClick (guarded in handler). Ellipsis exposed as a disabled 'More pages' button. announceToScreenReader live-region is a nice touch.
api: React.FC (no forwardRef), no style passthrough; className applied to both <nav> and inner glass (L256, L271); keys are index; registerPageRef calls requestAnimationFrame on every ref callback each render; usePagination returns {startIndex,endIndex} named 'currentItems'.
ssr: 'use client'; requestAnimationFrame inside ref callbacks only on client.
justification: Page-range logic is fine and the item-info compound is useful, but the controls are non-focusable divs (keyboard users cannot paginate at all) and each button stacks its own backdrop-filter, which is both visually noisy and expensive. Rebuild with real <button>/<a> items (asChild for router links), a single glass container, aria-current on the active page, and share it with the data-table paginators.

name: GlassResponsiveNav (alias ResponsiveNavigation)
material_impl: Composes GlassMobileNav and GlassBottomNav; desktop mode is a bespoke inline strip (glass-surface-overlay, inline transition) not using any glass primitive; wrapper adds glass-surface-subtle radius-xl.
motion: Inherited from children; useReducedMotion computed but unused (shouldReduceMotion never read, L136).
a11y: Wrapper role=navigation containing GlassBottomNav (role=tablist) and GlassMobileNav (role=dialog) and desktop links - nested/odd landmark structure; desktop fallback maps bottom items to href='#' anchors (L199-204, L269) - dead links; links get aria-current (good).
api: forwardRef; viewport switch in JS via window.innerWidth resize listener - initial render always 'desktop' so SSR/first paint on mobile flashes desktop then swaps; breakpoints not tied to tokens; elevation cast through 'as' (L228, L238) to types the children ignore anyway; navId and motion state unused.
ssr: 'use client'; hydration mismatch-free but layout shift on mobile (state defaults 'desktop', L144-146).
fake_complexity: tabletNavType='sidebar' renders the desktop strip, not a sidebar (comment L188-189).
target: GlassAppShell (app-shell) with CSS container/media-query driven chrome
justification: A JS-breakpoint switcher that inherits all of BottomNav's and MobileNav's defects, flashes desktop chrome on mobile first paint, fakes the 'sidebar' tablet mode and emits href='#' links. Responsive chrome belongs in the app-shell layout via CSS, not a runtime innerWidth listener.
